---
title: "MB1A practical 1-hpa"
author: "marianne szuba"
---

Some genes are classified as regionally elevated if they showed distinctly higher expression in these regions than in the rest of the brain. 
I want to calculate the total number of genes with regional expression in the forebrain--cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus, and hypothalamus--regions in human, pig, and mouse.

```{r}
# This code calculates the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain of humans
sum(180, 83, 57, 110)

# This code calculates the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain of pigs
sum(109, 157, 31, 45)

# This code calculates the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain of mice
sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
```
Humans have the *highest* number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain
